platform.configuration: SeLinRootConstructM1Adapter=ON; SeLinRootConstructM2ControlLease=ON; default production M0 and M1 proof profiles remain separate

contract.provenance: Root records only the TCB cap of the successfully M1-constructed suspended child and transfers exactly one cap copy through the same dedicated endpoint.
contract.lease: The taskd client sets one fixed CSpace cap receive path, validates one extra cap in the granted status reply, performs no TCB operation, then validates a duplicate rejection with zero extra caps.
contract.lifetime: There is no child start, resume, suspend, configuration, deletion, revocation, cleanup or reuse in M2.

required_markers: SeLinOS root construction M1: isolated taskd request endpoint ready.
SeLinOS root construction M1: exact fixed request accepted; root constructing.
SeLinOS root construction M1: one fixed child constructed and spawned suspended; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M1: malformed or duplicate request rejected; no allocation.
SeLinOS root construction M2: one constructed-child TCB control cap delivered; child remains suspended.
SeLinOS root construction M2: malformed, unavailable or duplicate lease rejected; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M2 taskd client: one provenance TCB cap received and not exercised; duplicate refused.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS root construction M1: unable to start taskd adapter client.
SeLinOS root construction M1: fixed child construction failed; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M2 taskd client: M1 construction or duplicate reply rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M2 taskd client: provenance lease reply rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M2 taskd client: duplicate lease refusal rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M1 inert child: unexpected execution.

not_claimed: restricted TCB-rights model, child start, resume, suspend, scheduler control, child configuration or a general capability distribution interface
second cap transfer, dynamic task allocation, teardown, cleanup, delete, revoke, unmap, release or reuse
non-root VKA, loader VSpace, root CNode, untyped memory, global VSpace, device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading, dynamic linker semantics, glibc runtime, dpkg or apt
